parts:
Dear all,

 

Join our online course “Design, Implement and Promote Species Monitoring in R”, taking place 19–21 October.

 

Course website: https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/species-monitoring-in-r/ 

 

Designed for researchers, students, practitioners and NGO professionals, this practical course will help you develop robust, reproducible species monitoring protocols and analyse real-world data in R.

 

You will explore and apply key monitoring approaches, including:

  • Capture-Mark-Recapture (CMR)
  • Distance sampling
  • Site occupancy
  • N-mixture models

 

Previous basic experience with R is desirable, but all scripts will be provided and explained step by step.

 

 

Best regards,
Carlo
